chapter: New Orleans memories and early drumming
title: Early music in New Orleans: his ambitions and picnic excursion boats
summary: Hall remembers wanting to play a funeral, a Mardi Gras parade and a picnic, and Ory's riverboat excursion jobs.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit more about your very first days, those bands up in the country. How old were you when you moved into New Orleans? I was about two and a half years old. Oh, very. You didn't remember anything. Oh no, nothing out then.

No, I was too young for that. The only thing first I can remember about music in New Orleans was when I was big enough to play and learn how to play, my biggest admirers, three things I wanted to do was to play a funeral, a mardi gras parade, and something else I can remember. I said if I'd ever do that I'd be satisfied. No, play it for a picnic. For a picnic.
Go up on a boat. See, they used to have excursion boats, and go up the country, and play that. And Ory used to get a lot of that stuff. Oh yeah. Right on the Mississippi River.
So I practically take the guy's job away from him. Yeah. They overhired me right on. I don't know why.
